title: Police Choke Chareidi Protester
body: Violent clashes erupt between police and chareidi demonstrators in Bnei Brak over the arrest of yeshiva students labeled as draft evaders. Graphic footage shows a police officer striking, choking, and throwing a young chareidi protester.

title: Mashpia Celebrates Son's Upsherin
body: Rav Ephraim Fishel Yisrael Weinberger, Av Beis Din of Turka, marked a milestone with the upsherin of his 3-year-old son, born after 34 years of marriage.

title: Rabbi Mandelbaum Stands Up
body: Rabbi Yanky Mandelbaum, founder of Yeshiva Orchos Chaim, spoke at the yeshiva's annual dinner in Lakewood, NJ, advocating for kavod haTorah. He addressed a large gathering of rabbonim and rabbeim.
